About

Pink Plastic women salon is a premium beauty destination designed exclusively for women.We specialize hair styling,cutting,coloring,nail care,skin care,waxing,threading,lash extensions,facials and relaxing body treatments.Our team of train professional is dedicated to providing exceptional services in modern ,hygienic and welcoming environments.Wheather you’re preparing for a special occasion or simply treating yourself,Pink Plastic Women Salon is perfect place to relax,refresh and feel your best.
